scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && PY=$(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m pytest --cov=app --cov-config=.coveragerc --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.seed: cd backend && PY=$(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m scripts.seed
